display.purpose: The score inside the evaluation gauge (38px); timers use the same treatment at 22px.

headline.purpose: Page titles; 26px on the brief hero, 28px on onboarding.

title.purpose: Panel and section titles; 15px on finding cards.

card-title.purpose: Station card titles, clamped to two lines on the tint.

reading.purpose: Speech bubbles; examiner questions at 15.5px semibold; feedback summary at 15.5px/1.65, max 75ch.

label.purpose: Field and filter labels, stepper steps, card meta; never a kicker above a heading.

fonts.reason: Matches the user's reference images; the CSP blocks remote fonts.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Panels, station cards, speech bubbles, result cards, the selected appearance segment.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Station card on hover or focus-within, with a 2px rise.

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Card shadow in the dark appearance.

shadows.name: lift-dark
shadows.purpose: Lift shadow in the dark appearance.

shadows.name: room
shadows.purpose: Card shadow inside the always-light consulting room.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Button, chip and field colour and border transitions.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Station card rise and shadow; illustration scale 300ms.

motion.name: gauge-sweep
motion.purpose: Score arc draws from zero once when feedback first arrives.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Finding cards staggered at 300/450/600/750ms; result caption at 1200ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables gauge sweep, rise-in and typing dots.

appearance.mechanism: Light / Dark / System setting sets nativeTheme.themeSource in the main process; the stylesheet follows prefers-color-scheme.
appearance.roomScope: .room keeps light tokens in both appearances; only room-sky and room-floor dim in dark.

iconography.style: Line icons on a 24px grid, 1.5 stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor, rendered 14 to 18px.

illustration.style: Hand-authored flat-outline SVG (no image generation was available); 2px round outline in ill-line, fixed friendly fills.
illustration.policy: Sensitive-topic stations use neutral imagery, never means of self-harm.

contrast.rule: text and text-2 pass WCAG AA on every tint in both appearances; text-3 is for panels and the canvas only, never on tints.

provenance.world: User-pinned reference world (four reference mock-ups), replacing the Examiner's Mark Sheet world.

narrative.overview:
DigiPat is a friendly, calm clinical-skills studio. Every station is a pastel case card with a flat-outline illustration on its tint; the consultation happens inside an illustrated consulting room where the conversation reads as speech bubbles; feedback lands as a coloured evaluation, a zoned gauge sweeping to the score, then pass or fail and tinted cards for what went well, what to improve and what to learn. The world was pinned by the user through four reference mock-ups and replaces the earlier printed mark-sheet world entirely.

Density is relaxed but not sparse: white panels on a cool off-white canvas, generous 16px corners, soft two-layer shadows, and one navy ink colour that carries text and the primary action. Colour lives in the tints, which own card tops, question cards, finding cards and notices, never text. Light and Dark are full appearances selected by the Light / Dark / System setting (the main process sets `nativeTheme.themeSource`, and the stylesheet follows `prefers-color-scheme`); in dark the shell turns charcoal, the tints become deep muted fills and the primary becomes a light pill, while the consulting room stays a light sky scene.

The system rejects the earlier mark-sheet world (red-ink rules, condensed verdict type, paper textures), and it does not copy the references' non-product elements: no user profile, no name greeting, no notifications.
keyCharacteristics: Cool canvas, white panels, navy ink; pastel tints carry all colour.
One family, Plus Jakarta Sans, self-hosted; tabular numerals for every figure.
Soft, rounded, shadowed: 10-16px radii on controls and panels, pills fully round.
Hand-authored flat-outline SVG illustration with an outline token that flips for dark.
Line icons at 1.5 stroke, round caps and joins.
Full light and dark appearances; the consulting room stays light in both.

rules.name: The Ink on Tint Rule
rules.body: On any tint, including the lighter lower band of a station card, text is Navy Ink or Slate Ink only. Both were measured to pass WCAG AA on every tint in both appearances. Quiet Ink is for panels and the canvas, never on a tint.

rules.name: The Tint Owns the Surface Rule
rules.body: Tints fill surfaces (card tops, question and finding cards, notices, the patient bubble); they are never text colours and never borders. One tint per card; a card's lower band is a lighter step of its own hue, not a second colour.

rules.name: The One Navy Voice Rule
rules.body: The navy accent is the only saturated action colour. One primary pill per decision region; everything else is a quiet outlined button.

rules.name: The Light Room Rule
rules.body: The consulting room keeps its light sky scene and light tokens in both appearances; in dark only the sky and floor step down. The room is a place, not a panel.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere, bundled locally. Hierarchy comes from size and weight (400 to 700), not from a second family, uppercase or letter-spaced caps.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every score, percentage, time and count uses tabular numerals so figures do not jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Two shadows only, both diffuse and ambient. Depth answers state (hover, focus); nothing at rest floats higher than a card.

dos: Do set text on any tint, including a station card's lower band, in Navy Ink or Slate Ink only.
Do give each station one tint for its whole card: the full tint on top, a 42% oklab mix with the surface below.
Do keep one navy primary pill per decision region, with outlined secondary buttons beside it.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans from the bundled @fontsource files, weights 400 to 700, and tabular numerals for every figure.
Do use the 1.5-stroke line icon set, round caps and joins, at 16 to 18px.
Do keep the consulting room light in both appearances and let old transcript lines fade under the top mask.
Do honour reduced motion: the gauge sweep, rise-in and typing dots switch off.
Do keep the educational-simulation badge, the AI-feedback caveat and the sensitive-topic helpline footer visible.
donts: Don't put Quiet Ink (text-3) on a tint; it is for panels and the canvas only.
Don't load fonts or images from a remote origin; the CSP forbids it and the app is offline.
Don't depict means of self-harm in any illustration; sensitive-topic stations use neutral imagery (a mind motif, a sprout).
Don't use tints as text or border colours, or mix two tints on one card.
Don't put a small uppercase or letter-spaced label above a heading; field labels label controls only.
Don't use hard offset or coloured shadows; depth is the two soft ambient shadows.
Don't add a user profile, name greeting or notifications from the references; they are not product truth.
Don't bring back the mark-sheet world: red-ink rules, condensed verdict type or paper textures.
